summary: Invoice gap and temporary negative balance after delayed multi-region postback reconciliation
description:
Issue summary: Customer observed a gap on their provisional invoice that resulted in a temporary negative balance. The invoice line for hourly reserved credits in us-east and eu-west showed missing credit allocation for a 3-hour window on 2026-03-09 correlated with a spike of delayed postbacks from edge collectors. Impact: customer-facing autopay failed and customer received an overdrawn provisional invoice notification. Environment: dedicated deployment spanning us-east and eu-west, prod traffic, reserved capacity with fallback to hosted during GPU saturation.

Detailed timeline: 2026-03-09 02:07 UTC — intermittent increased latency at edge collectors in eu-west. 2026-03-09 02:10–05:20 UTC — postbacks from eu-west were delayed and queued; reconciliation worker backlog grew. 2026-03-09 06:15 UTC — partial replay of postbacks caused mixed ordering and duplicate suppression to prune some expected credit postbacks. 2026-03-10 09:00 UTC — customer flagged a negative provisional balance and reached Support.

Requested outcome: clear invoice explanation, provisional credit applied immediately to unblock autopay, and a persistent fix to avoid similar out-of-order postback gaps in reconciler.
impact: Autopay blocked for customer account; finance team escalated; potential customer billing dispute and SLA exposure for reserved capacity accounting.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Simulate sustained producer-side network degradation in eu-west collectors for ~3 hours.
2) Allow postback queue in edge collectors to grow and delay delivery to the postback API.
3) Trigger reconciliation job run after backlog clears (scheduled replay).
4) Observe reconciler ordering and duplicate-suppression behavior; verify hourly credit lines for the affected window are missing or reduced on provisional invoice generation run.
comments: 2026-03-10 Sophie Reynolds (Support): Opened after customer reported negative provisional balance. Collected initial logs and escalated to Billing + SRE.
2026-03-10 Jenna Li (Cerebro Analytics): We saw autopay fail and an overdraft notice. Please advise if this will affect the finalized invoice or if it's provisional only.
2026-03-10 Elena Park (Billing): Confirming provisional invoice shows missing 3 hourly credit lines for 2026-03-09 02:00-05:00 UTC. Preparing provisional credit while SRE investigates root cause.

2026-03-11 Anand Kapoor (SRE): Reconciler backlog identified; replay ordering caused 13 suppressed postbacks due to duplicate-suppression TTL logic. Working on backfill and ordering fix (PR referenced).
2026-03-12 Diego Martinez (Assignee): Applied provisional credit of $1,240.00 to unblock autopay; scheduled reconciler backfill for 2026-03-12 22:00 UTC.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: duplicated postback suppression incorrectly flagged legitimate replayed postbacks as duplicates when ordering changed during replay.
SRE confirmed clock skew ~2s between eu-west collectors and reconciler during burst; threshold logic combined with out-of-order delivery pruned postbacks that carried hourly-credit tags.
Billing ingest accepted replays but hourly_accumulator keyed on ingest ordering which resulted in missing hourly bucket entries for the window.

Safe remediation: replay suppressed postbacks with explicit dedupe-hints and run a backfill to rehydrate hourly accumulator. Long-term: adjust duplicate-suppression TTL and make accumulator idempotency tolerant to out-of-order events.
resolution: Provisional credit applied; reconciler backfill scheduled; code fix merged to reduce false duplicate suppression; monitoring and alerting added for postback queue growth and replay ordering anomalies.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-12: Applied provisional credit to Cerebro Analytics account — $1,240.00 provisional line item CREDIT-PROV-881990.
2026-03-12: Merged PR https://github.com/redwood/reconciler/pull/2245 updating duplicate-suppression to include replay-consistency hints.

2026-03-12: Backfill completed 2026-03-12 23:45 UTC; billing ingestion confirmed hourly accumulator entries for 2026-03-09 02:00-05:00 UTC were restored. Provisional credit reversed and applied as final adjustment on next billing cycle.
Follow-up: Create postmortem runbook, tune thresholds, and run a dedicated chaos test for replay ordering scenarios. Assigned to Anand Kapoor (SRE) for 30-day remediation plan.
billing_action_required: Applied provisional credit and scheduled final adjustment after backfill; finance to confirm final invoice change and notify customer once finalized.
